correlationId.description: Opaque cross-cell correlation identifier from the originating request context. Lets consumers stitch an audited action back to its request. Empty for entries predating its introduction.

traceId.description: Opaque distributed trace identifier from the originating request context. Lets consumers correlate an audited action back to its trace. Empty for entries predating its introduction.

scope.description: Origin of the audit row relative to the calling tenant: "tenant" for the caller's own-tenant rows, "system" for tenant-less framework/system rows (e.g. bootstrap.auth.fail) that the per-tenant RLS read clause surfaces to every tenant (#1618). Lets a tenant admin distinguish their own audit trail from global system events without exposing any other tenant's id. Empty for rows predating its introduction.
